spitzerPixelIdentity.pixelConvention: Native TIFF orientation 1 (top-left raster). AVM/FITS WCS reference pixels one-based, bottom-left. No transpose/flip/rotation performed.
spitzerPixelIdentity.claim: NASA working TIFF and AVM-bearing Spitzer master have identical decoded RGB grids; publisher WCS is transferable without fitting.

limitations: Byte equality proves publisher-image correspondence, not accuracy against an independent star catalogue.
No held-out matches, uncertainty covariance or physical depth measurements have been created.
The 2MASS and IRIS recipe URLs include exact requested WCS; this is a service-defined output grid, not newly solved astrometry.
